action_items.task: Document SHIPLOG_REMOTE usage in README/feature docs

key_decisions: SHIPLOG_REMOTE env/git config drives all Shiplog pushes and fetches
Default git pushes now add --no-verify to avoid user pre-push conflicts
summary: Enabled configurable Shiplog remotes with --no-verify pushes across CLI/scripts and added regression coverage plus docs updates for SHIPLOG_REMOTE.

topics.issue: Users couldn't redirect Shiplog refs or skip pre-push hooks

topics.what: Added shiplog_remote_name helper and rewired CLI auto-push/publish/setup flows
topics.why: auto-push previously hardcoded origin and ignored workflows with dedicated refs

topics.future_work: Expose remote override flags directly on helper scripts
topics.issue: Automation reused git push origin and triggered hooks

topics.context: New remote plumbing required guard rails
